backtest_protocol.execution_model: DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance is read as a raw SEC Companyfacts balance-sheet INSTANT fact and known only by filed date (<= signal date). Current and prior allowance/revenue ratios use annual revenue and pretax context filed by the signal date and period-ended no later than the allowance period. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: raw SEC companyfacts DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance instant facts
raw SEC companyfacts annual revenue facts
raw SEC companyfacts annual pretax income facts
raw SEC companyfacts filed date and period end

2_history_check.exp-20260616-005: Rejected effective tax-burden relief. This run does not retune tax expense or effective tax-rate thresholds; it tests the deferred tax asset valuation allowance balance-sheet field.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-029: Rejected principal debt burden relief. This run avoids financing liability burden and tests a tax asset valuation reserve.
2_history_check.exp-20260617-008: Rejected impairment overhang relief. This run tests future taxable income confidence, not goodwill/asset impairment overhang.
2_history_check.exp-20260617-012: Rejected SBC grant-value backlog relief. This run is not SBC or grant-value normalization.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Mechanism: a falling deferred-tax-asset valuation allowance is an auditor-reviewed accounting-quality field that can signal higher confidence in future taxable income. Related tax-burden and raw Companyfacts quality scouts were mostly rejected on old_thin/drawdown, so probability is low; this is materially different from effective tax rate, debt, impairment, lease, working-capital, and SBC threshold retunes.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC valuation allowance, annual revenue, or pretax income facts, missing prior comparison point, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC valuation allowance tag, filed-date PIT annual revenue/pretax context, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
